scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.lint: eslint client/src server/src server/test shared/src e2e
